_meta.purpose: Brand-neutral spec-class reference for licence-free (<=25km/h, <=250W, non-RC) EVs in the Tricity market.
_meta.rule: Compare by CLASS and SPEC. List >=3 brands per class. Prices are BANDS, never exact ex-showroom. Zelio appears only as one representative among others.
_meta.verify_before_publish: Confirm each non-Zelio representative is actually a low-speed (<=25km/h, <=250W, non-RC) variant before publishing — some brands sell same-name models in both low- and high-speed trims. The Komaki entry here is the 'XGT VP' specifically, as bare 'XGT'/'XGT KM' trims appear in registered/high-speed form in several sources; confirm the VP variant locally before relying on it.
